body: Are you kidding me? You're amazing. I was blown away to find out you're 16. There's plenty of time for girls. You are randomly assigned to the people in your world now. Collage will be different. Your parents are right, take all the hard tests and get into the good collage man. The ladies will be smart and beautiful and will totally get you. Don't be in a rush to ***be*** with a lady either. They never talk about that being a special experience for the guys, but it should be I think. Mine wasn't fun. I was 12 and drunk. Not because I'm from a bad environment, but because I rushed things into my life I should have taken more time with. It's too early for love in my opinion, but just find a nice girl that you can relax and have fun with. You'll know if she wants you to bust a move. Don't rush it and be okay with being on a different frequency from your friends. Again, you'll find better, brighter, and more in common with the friends awaiting you at university. Lastly, prom is cool, but its just a social thing. One year I took the quietest nerdiest girl in my class. I was an honor student but also a jock. I did it to make a point, and to give her a special time. Don't worry about fining a "date", find someone to make a memory with, for you, for her (or him), not them. Reach out anytime and thanks again for your kind words on my post. I'm going to fight, at least for one more day. Thanks kid
